title: Frozen backflow preventer: document damage before a thaw becomes a failure
description: Freeze exposure can damage the body, covers, check components, shutoffs, fittings, and adjacent piping.
prompt: Is this a frozen assembly, a cracked assembly, or a downstream pipe failure?
answer: Freeze exposure can damage the body, covers, check components, shutoffs, fittings, and adjacent piping. Identify the exact point of damage before thawing, pressurizing, or ordering an internal kit.
urgency: Do not force valves, apply open flame, or re-pressurize a visibly cracked assembly. Escalate active leaks or a damaged protected connection.
identifiers: Look for split bodies, distorted covers, cracked fittings, and separated piping joints.
Record the device model, size, location, and whether it is an exposed irrigation installation.
A freeze-related failure may require replacement scope beyond service parts.

choices.label: I know the model and size
choices.detail: Use model-specific sources before ordering parts or accepting a repair scope.

choices.label: The assembly is leaking or failed
choices.detail: Document the location and obtain a qualified diagnosis before repair.

choices.label: The body may be damaged
choices.detail: Compare repair with a complete replacement and retest scope.

steps.title: Observe and identify
steps.body: Photograph all visible damage while the system is isolated.

steps.title: Match the verified path
steps.body: Determine whether the damage is limited to a confirmed serviceable component or includes body and piping work.

steps.title: Close the risk loop
steps.body: Plan the safe repair or replacement plus required retest before return to service.

safeChecks: Keep the area accessible and dry where possible.
Use a qualified isolation and thawing procedure.
Preserve the model label before damaged components are removed.
stopConditions: The body or adjacent pipe is cracked.
The protected line cannot be safely isolated.
notThisDevice: A product-family name alone does not establish component compatibility.
A generic online part listing is not a repair diagnosis.
This page does not replace a qualified on-site assessment.
evidenceNote: Use exact manufacturer literature and the governing utility or authority record to validate the device, service path, and compliance closeout.
